The backup contains the library with reading progress, bookmarks, quotes and notes, the dictionary and the reader, speech and translation settings — in a single file. Site passwords and sessions, downloaded models and voices are not included.

“Next”, “back”, “pause”, “continue”, “next paragraph”. The microphone listens only while the speech player is open; recognition runs on the device, no audio is sent anywhere. Works better with headphones: the microphone may pick up the speech itself.

Battery use: the microphone and recognition run continuously while the book is being read — roughly 5–10% of charge per hour on top of the speech itself; depends on the device. Outside the player the cost is zero.
The multilingual-e5-small model finds passages by meaning, not by words. Downloaded once (≈%1$s MB), works offline. Without it, regular search is used.

Sign-ins to web novel and book sites. Passwords are kept in the device’s secure storage (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain), sessions (cookies) are encrypted, and nothing goes into backups. The app does not bypass captchas or site protection.
If a site asks you to sign in, the app will offer to enter a login and password or sign in with the built-in browser.
The saved login, password and session for this site will be deleted. Downloaded books will stay.

Images from the internet are cached on disk (up to 160 MB, old ones are removed automatically). Pages of downloaded web novels are kept in a separate app folder until you assemble a book from them; after an interruption the download resumes from where it stopped.

Reading and listening time is counted while pages are turned or sentences are spoken. Pauses, background and idle time longer than three minutes are not counted. Statistics are stored on the device and included in the backup.
Open a book and read or listen — statistics will appear here.
Time, speed and streak will be zeroed. Books and bookmarks are not affected.
The file in the cloud was created by a newer version of LocalDoc. Update the app.

Reading progress, bookmarks, quotes and collections are saved in one file on your WebDAV server (Nextcloud, ownCloud and others), encrypted with a password on the device. The encryption password must be the same on all devices — it cannot be recovered. Site passwords are not synced.
A backup is saved on the device before any choice.
Take the data from the cloud
iCloud and Google Drive: not available yet.
Last backups kept: %1$s. Backups are stored in the app’s memory and disappear when it is uninstalled — for safety, occasionally save a backup as a file in the “Backup” section.

How long the app waits between requests to one site. The faster it is, the higher the risk that the site takes the download for an attack and restrict access; if a site specifies a pause in robots.txt (Crawl-delay), it is respected in any mode.
In the background, on a schedule. The system may shift the start time to save battery. The app only reports new chapters — you start the download.

No questions asked: sites with a self-signed, expired or mismatched certificate open right away. Unsafe on networks you do not control. When off, the app asks about each site separately and remembers the answer.

Speech, translation and AI work in chunks of text in any mode — a large book won’t freeze.

Joins lines cut in the middle of a sentence, restores words broken by hyphenation, separates glued paragraphs and removes page numbers and running headers. Bookmarks, quotes and your reading position are kept.
Choose a model to check doubtful places with the neural network. Without it only the built-in rules apply.
Summarize the document in exactly 5 points. Each point is one paragraph.
Extract all key facts, figures, names and dates from the text as a structured list. Do not invent anything.
Translate and adapt the text into simple English, preserving the structure and meaning.
Explain the content of the document in plain words, as for someone without specialist knowledge.

You are a precise local document analyst. Answer strictly based on the provided text, in English. Use clear structure, lists, and highlight key facts, figures and conclusions. Do not invent facts that are not in the source.

A reasoning model: it "thinks" first, then answers. Good for logic and tasks, slower in chat.
A proven Google model: coherent retellings and careful wording.
A fast model optimized for Qualcomm / Apple mobile chips.
The optimal balance: clean Russian, accurate summaries and answers about books.
A Microsoft model with a long context: strong in analysis and reasoning, better in English.
The strongest compact Google model: deep retellings and answers on complex texts.
A flagship for smartphones: the quality of large models, excellent Russian.
The new Qwen generation in an ultra-light package: runs even on budget phones, fast summaries.
A fresh compact Qwen 3.5: smarter than earlier models of the same size, excellent Russian.
The Qwen 3.5 flagship for smartphones: large-model quality with the best Russian.
Server-grade quality. Requires 12+ GB of RAM and heats the battery more.
